title: Smoke probe choreography and eval signal aggregation for preflight gating
creator: Jordan Lee
description: Build a lightweight, composable preflight subsystem that runs fast smoke probes and aggregates heterogeneous eval signals into a single preflight health score used by rollout gates. Goals: 1) Orchestrate ordered probes (API sanity, model-token-compat, KV cache prime, short perf microbench) across target deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) and canary cohorts; 2) Compute delta fingerprints for output-quality and latency (p50/p95/p99) against baseline and detect regressions with configurable hysteresis windows; 3) Surface a concise health delta and suggested guardrails to the console and orchestration layer to allow automated canary hold/rollback and manual review flows. Must be low-cost (sub-10s total wall time for normal preflight), deterministic, and compatible with LTS channel policies (allow stable-only gating vs. tolerant nightly gating).
acceptance_criteria: A preflight job spec format exists (YAML) that declares probes, ordering, cohort targets, and thresholds
System runs a full default preflight (10 probes) in under 12s on dedicated CI hardware and under 20s on equivalent private infra
Aggregated health score computed deterministically from weighted signals: functionality(40%), quality(30%), latency(20%), infra(10%)
Perf regression detector flags >5% increase in p95 or p99 from baseline with a configurable 10-minute stability window
Eval fingerprinting stores a compact signature of model outputs and reports divergence > 1.5% token-level edit distance across eval set
Console shows preflight summary tile with health score, top-3 failing probes, and rollback suggestion link
Orchestrator accepts a binary pass/fail and a health_delta payload so rollout policies can act (pause/rollback/continue)
Integration tests cover hosted + dedicated + private permutations and at least one LTS channel policy (stable-only)
